convergence.description: IOS-flavored convergence checks for the cisco_iol L3VPN (mpls-l3vpn.iol.yml). NOTE: stage is 'runtime', NOT 'config-time', ON PURPOSE — Twinlab's test-suite runner execs via clab-api (docker exec = the container's Linux shell), which cannot reach the IOS CLI on an iol node (unlike VyOS, whose vtysh is an in-container binary). These commands were hand-verified over SSH (admin/admin) and are staged here ready for the planned SSH/CLI (network_cli) validation transport; once that lands, flip stage to 'config-time' to gate config-done like the VyOS sibling. Until then, running this suite via the current transport will error. Customer loopbacks (10.2.0.1-.4) are netlab-derived and hardcoded — see the test-suite-hardcoded-ips follow-up.

ospf_full.description: Every node has a FULL OSPF adjacency (the area-0 core is up).

ldp_operational.description: Every node has an LDP session in State: Oper (MPLS transport LSPs established).

vpnv4_routes_imported.description: Each PE has installed BGP-learned (MP-BGP VPNv4) customer routes in the vpn_a VRF.

vpn_reach_pe1_to_pe2.description: pe1 reaches pe2's customer site across the L3VPN (data plane over the label-switched core).

vpn_reach_pe1_to_pe3.description: pe1 reaches pe3's customer site across the L3VPN.

vpn_reach_pe1_to_pe4.description: pe1 reaches pe4's customer site across the L3VPN.

vpn_reach_pe4_to_pe1.description: pe4 reaches pe1's customer site (reverse path) across the L3VPN.
